decision: sample continuing transfer byte progress at the Models owner while publishing every control/artifact boundary

behavior.sampling: one private pending snapshot per task; continuing Downloading bytes publish at most once per 100ms when another update arrives
behavior.boundaries: state, artifact index/count, retry, total-byte change or byte reset bypass sampling; pending latest bytes merge before publication
behavior.subscribers: new subscribers see the published snapshot matching the task file, not a pending sample; existing write-failure behavior is unchanged
behavior.runtime: reuse existing per-task serialization mutex, no timer, worker, dependency or public schema field added
behavior.recovery: resume offsets still come from actual .part length; no reliance on sampled byte counters
behavior.artifactIndex: chunk callback index is zero-based, completed marker index is one-based; display each current artifact correctly while retaining zero-byte completion markers
